# Aria Kianzad

> Brand strategist and copywriter. Personal website: [ariakianzad.github.io](https://ariakianzad.github.io/)

I work on brand strategy and copywriting. My focus is helping brands understand what they should stand for, why that difference matters, and how to communicate it clearly.

## Personal website

The personal website is a static, single-page introduction to my work:

- Perspective: why more output is not always the answer.
- Disciplines: brand strategy and copywriting.
- Approach: clarity before volume, meaningful differentiation, and language as part of strategy.
- Rexo: the independent brand strategy and creative studio I founded in 2024, at [rexo.agency](https://rexo.agency/).
- About and contact: [kianzadaria@gmail.com](mailto:kianzadaria@gmail.com).

## Persian book: «میانِ ما»

I also publish the Persian book page for **«میانِ ما»**, about understanding relationships, emotional intimacy, commitment, communication and emotional responsibility.

- Book page: [ariakianzad.github.io/Mian-e-Ma/](https://ariakianzad.github.io/Mian-e-Ma/)
- Direct PDF: [Mian-e-Ma.pdf](https://ariakianzad.github.io/Mian-e-Ma/assets/Mian-e-Ma.pdf)
- Language: Persian (fa-IR).
- Publisher: مجله رکسو.
- Author: آریا کیانزاد.
